Andy Barclay | Andrew William "Andy" Barclay is a fictional character and protagonist of the "Child's Play" horror film series. In reality the murders are being committed by the doll, which was possessed by serial killer Charles Lee Ray (aka Chucky).  The duo will go on to become archenemies.
